bias.zh: 偏空 · 重回 200 日均线上方

read.en: Rockwell Automation rose 0.8% on Oct 20 to $427.77, recovering from a low of $413.85 to $429.24. It is back above the falling 5-day ($424.8) and rising 200-day ($426.1) averages, but below the falling 10-day ($429.9), 30-day ($430.1) and 100-day ($447.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and is below zero, its histogram narrowing, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($448.70), and RSI is 46.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 10月20日上涨 0.8%，收于 $427.77，自 $413.85 低点回升至 $429.24。股价重回下行的 5 日（$424.8）和上行的 200 日均线（$426.1）上方，但低于下行的 10 日（$429.9）、30 日（$430.1）和 100 日均线（$447.7）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$448.70），RSI 为 46。

read.en: After testing the $412.7 Oct 15 low, the close reclaimed the 200-day lost on Oct 19. Resistance is $429.2–430.1 (Oct 20 high, 10 and 30-day averages), then $436 (Sep 8, Oct 14 highs) and $447.7–448.7 (100-day, SAR). Support is $424.8–426.1 (5 and 200-day), then $412.7–413.9 (Oct 15, 20 lows) and $406.9. A close above $430.1 would open $436; a close below $412.7 would open $406.9.
